deferred_follow_up: Built-in structured-text PII and PHI detection has real mutation evidence, but comprehensive sensitive-data protection remains DEFERRED-FOLLOW-UP. The conformance test proves a benign JSON response remains clean while SSN and MRN markers are blocked or redacted without retaining the raw identifiers. Regex detection cannot cover every identifier or context, and this test does not scan image or binary output or prove that regulated deployments enable the guard with local patterns. Follow-up work must qualify deployment-specific detectors, non-text extraction, guard activation policy, and recall and false-positive evaluation.
note: Real partial mutation evidence. The conformance test at crates/tooling/chio-conformance/tests/threats/pii_phi_exposure.rs calls ResponseSanitizationGuard::scan_response on a benign JSON control and on a payload containing SSN and MRN markers. Block mode must report both findings; redact mode must remove both raw identifiers and record at least two redactions. A targeted cargo-mutants run replaced ResponseSanitizationGuard::scan with vec![]; the sensitive payload was classified clean and the block assertion caught the leak bypass. PARTIAL: local identifier patterns, non-text content, deployment activation, and detector-quality qualification remain deferred.
